def modify_features(X, history):
    # Compute time-safe past180 days statistic: average price for each customer cohort
    avg_price_history = history.groupby(['customer_id'])['price'].mean()
    # Compute time-safe past180 days statistic: count of article categories for each customer cohort
    article_count_history = history.groupby(['customer_id'])['article_id'].count()
    # Compute time-safe past180 days statistic: average age for each customer cohort
    avg_age_history = history.groupby(['customer_id'])['customer_age'].mean()
    
    # Merge past 180 days history statistics with the candidate pairs on customer ID
    F = pd.DataFrame(index=X.index)
    F['avg_price'] = pd.merge(X, avg_price_history.to_frame('avg_price'), left_on='customer_id', right_index=True, validate='many_to_one', how='left')['avg_price']
    F['article_count'] = pd.merge(X, article_count_history.to_frame('article_count'), left_on='customer_id', right_index=True, validate='many_to_one', how='left')['article_count']
    F['avg_age'] = pd.merge(X, avg_age_history.to_frame('avg_age'), left_on='customer_id', right_index=True, validate='many_to_one', how='left')['avg_age']
    
    # Filter days_ago for calendar-day windows
    days_ago_filter = (history['days_ago'] <= 180)
    
    # Compute feature: proportion of past 180 days articles that belong to the same product category
    same_category_proportion = history.groupby('customer_id')['article_id'].apply(lambda x: np.mean(np.in1d(history['article_id'], x, keep=True)))
    F['same_category_proportion'] = same_category_proportion
    
    # Compute feature: average number of days between purchases of the same article
    avg_days_same_article = history.groupby('article_id')['days_ago'].apply(lambda x: (x.max() - x.min()))
    F['avg_days_same_article'] = avg_days_same_article.mean()
    
    # Compute feature: number of consecutive days the customer purchased from the same product category
    consecutive_days_same_category = history.groupby('customer_id')['days_ago'].apply(lambda x: (x.max() - x.min()))
    F['consecutive_days_same_category'] = consecutive_days_same_category
    
    # Filter days_ago for calendar-day windows
    F['days_ago'] = history['days_ago']
    F = F[days_ago_filter]
    
    return F
